title: Smiling Boy Holding Birthday Cake in Yard, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful young boy proudly balances a thick frosted cake on a platter outside on a sunny lawn. He wears late-1940s attire consisting of a short-sleeved open-collar shirt and high-waisted, wide-leg trousers with deep cuffs secured by a belt. In the background, a Craftsman-style home, hedges, and a tall evergreen complete this quintessential scene of mid-century American suburban family life.
